retrievalProfile.description: Generates a postage-stamp-themed layout featuring a central portrait against a flag backdrop with high-contrast gold beveled lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition framed by a white perforated postage stamp border, featuring a central figure in front of a waving national flag, topped with heavy, metallic gold-beveled typography and a currency-style denomination.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast flag background
Large-scale gold typography anchored at the top
Perforated white border framing the entire scene
Currency denomination placed in the upper right quadrant
Graphic overlays in the lower left corner providing texture
coreInvariants: Gold metallic bevel effect on all primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a male figure, scaled to occupy the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large gold 'MASTER' text at the top and the white perforated border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top gold text, moves down to the subject's face, then to the currency value on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the flag pattern and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Red and blue from the flag background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White from the tank top and the perforated border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Polished gold for the typography and currency symbols.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the flag colors contrasted with high-value white and metallic highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D beveling with internal light glints
characterSpecificRedesigns: Currency symbol 'c' with a vertical strike-through
Numbers with high-contrast thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform use of a single bold serif family with varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic serif skeleton for the bevel effect.
High contrast strokes match the currency-style numbers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a white tank top centered in front of a waving American flag, framed by a white perforated postage stamp border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, gold-beveled serif text at the top and a gold currency value '33c' in the upper right using a high-contrast serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the white border perforated like a stamp?
Does the text have a 3D gold metallic bevel?
Is the background a waving flag pattern?
Is the currency symbol present in the upper right?

avoid: Flat yellow text instead of gold bevel

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Check that the currency symbol is correctly styled
recipe.reuseFormula: Postage Stamp Frame + Waving Flag Background + Central Portrait + Gold Beveled Serif Typography = Urban Philatelic Aesthetic
